correctness.rationale: The known vertex formula gives an exact signed-rank objective classification; Gaussian signed chambers yield finite cone masses and the derived r-direction moment sums with exact exceptional first-parameter correction. The new analysis is a rigorous fixed-r discrete saddle: for x=n^(1/r), local Stirling weights of sum n^j/(j!)^r converge on the sqrt(x) scale to variance 1/r, while (n)_j/n^j tends to e^-1/2 exactly at r=2 and to one at all fixed r>=3, with negligible tails. This proves the sharp universal constant and conditioned-rank CLT. Exact finite chamber calculations replayed across 12 cases for r=2,3,4 and separate stable asymptotic numerical checks; no finite test substitutes for the analytic limits.
